mapper.select: SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "groupId", c.code, c.code_nm AS "name", (c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS active, m.src_text AS source FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code_map m ON m.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id AND m.code=c.code WHERE c.code_grp_id IN ('CLNT_TYPE','INDUTY','BANK') ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code,m.map_id
SELECT biz_reg_no AS "businessNo",clnt_nm AS name FROM tb_bs_clnt

SELECT upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS filename,file_size AS size, reg_user_id AS actor,upld_stat_cd AS status,tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows", warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows",aply_dttm AS "appliedAt" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT rslt_sn AS sequence,rslt_type_cd AS severity,row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName", coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS reason FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn
